events.body:
## Context

`parse_funding_file` in `.github/scripts/funding/owasp_funding_yml_scraper.py` throws away the FUNDING.yml keys (`github:`, `patreon:`, `custom:`...) and keeps only the values, so a `github: OWASP` entry becomes the bare string `OWASP`. Since the escaping fix in 9a5cf08265, `safe_href` drops any value that isn't an absolute http(s) URL, so those donors' links now disappear from the page instead of 404ing. Only `custom:` URLs survive. The heart links also have no accessible name. The site's whole purpose is directing donors.

## What to do

1. Keep key/value pairs and map platforms to URLs (github to `https://github.com/sponsors/<v>`; open_collective, patreon, ko_fi, liberapay, buy_me_a_coffee similarly; custom as-is).
2. Give each link an `aria-label` like "Sponsor OWASP on GitHub Sponsors".
3. Add cases to `test/test_funding_render.py` with sample FUNDING.yml content.

> **Note:** Keep the output going through the existing `esc()` and `safe_href()` helpers; build full URLs before they reach `safe_href`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No relative funding links
- [ ] Each platform has its URL pattern
- [ ] Links have accessible names
- [ ] Test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-tomato && GITHUB_TOKEN=<your token> OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/t python3 .github/scripts/funding/owasp_funding_yml_scraper.py   # open /tmp/t/index.html
```

---
